dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Apr 13 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q5q0](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q5q0) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 65.942 depth occurred on Apr 13 2025 28km S of Mindik. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.7259 longitude 147.4178. It impacted 165646 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
